units.source_text: 且说宇治山庄中，两女公子都觉得仿佛做了一梦，心情异常恼乱。

en.t: Meanwhile, at the Uji villa, both young ladies felt as though they had been dreaming, and their hearts were terribly disturbed.

units.source_text: 二女公子想起姐姐做这种种摆布，却装作不知，实在可恶可恨，因此看也不去看她。

en.t: The younger lady thought of how her elder sister had arranged all this while pretending to know nothing, and found it so hateful and unforgivable that she would not even look at her.

units.source_text: 大女公子呢，并不知道昨夜会发生此事，不能预先向妹妹说明。

en.t: As for the elder lady, she had not known that such a thing would happen the night before, and so she could not explain it to her younger sister in advance.

units.source_text: 但觉妹妹可怜，她的恨我是理之当然。

en.t: She only felt sorry for her younger sister, thinking it was only natural that she should hate her.

units.source_text: 众侍女都来问候：“大小姐是怎么一回事？”

en.t: All the waiting women came to ask after them, saying, What has happened, my lady?

units.source_text: 然而这位身为家主的长姐已经气得发昏，不知所云。

en.t: But the elder sister, who was the mistress of the household, was already so overcome with anger that she was dazed and scarcely knew what she was saying.

units.source_text: 众侍女都弄得莫名其妙。

en.t: The waiting women were all left completely bewildered.

units.source_text: 大女公子将匂亲王来信启开，想给妹妹看。

en.t: The elder lady opened the letter that had come from Prince Niou and wanted to show it to her younger sister.

units.source_text: 然而二女公子只管躺着，不肯起身。

en.t: But the younger lady simply lay there and refused to get up.

units.source_text: 送信的使者等得不耐烦，催促道：“等候多时了。”

en.t: The messenger who had brought the letter grew impatient with waiting and pressed them, saying, I have been waiting for quite some time.
